budgetsPage.addAMonthlyBudgetFor: Add a monthly budget for a team or a tag.

budgetsPage.theSpendStaysOnlyThe: The spend stays; only the budget goes.

anomaliesPage.noDayHasCostFar: No day has cost far more than usual.
anomaliesPage.nothingHasBeenDecidedThis: Nothing has been decided this way.

rulesPage.serviceNamesTakeAndAs: Service names take * and ? as wildcards; case does not matter.

costSettingsPage.aThreeLetterCodeSuch: A three-letter code, such as USD or EUR.
costSettingsPage.anAnomalyIsAtLeast: An anomaly is at least this much more than usual ({{currency}})
costSettingsPage.spendInACurrencyWithout: Spend in a currency without a rate is left out of every figure, and each page says so. Rates are fixed until you change them; nothing is fetched.
costSettingsPage.allSpendIsInThe: All spend is in the reporting currency, or none has been sent yet.
costSettingsPage.aRateForACurrency: A rate for a currency that has one replaces it.

setupPage.aPipelineSendsTheBill: A pipeline sends the bill, once a day or as often as the provider updates it. Cost reads it; it holds no cloud credentials.
setupPage.costExplorerSAnswerTurned: Cost Explorer's answer, turned into spend lines by tools/ce-to-records.mjs from the repository. Use COST_INGEST_TOKEN, set where cost runs, or an API token with the editor role.
setupPage.jsonNdjsonOrCsvOptionally: JSON, NDJSON or CSV, optionally gzipped. In CSV, tags are columns named tag:team.
setupPage.aDaySentAgainReplaces: A day sent again replaces what was there, so a daily job can send the whole month. With replace=true, lines the new export no longer has go too.
setupPage.aTeamTagNamesThe: A team tag names the owner. Spend without one goes to the first rule that matches, or to nobody.
setupPage.creditsAreNegativeAmountsSpend: Credits are negative amounts. Spend in another currency counts once it has a rate under Settings.
